query:
SELECT d.filename, COUNT(t.id) as cnt 
FROM documents d 
JOIN transcriptions t ON t."documentId" = d.id 
WHERE d."projectId" = (SELECT id FROM projects WHERE name LIKE '%Behna%' LIMIT 1)
GROUP BY d.filename 
HAVING COUNT(t.id) > 1 
ORDER BY COUNT(t.id) DESC 
LIMIT 15;
